summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc. (Nasdaq: CMND) filed a Form 6-K on October 7, 2026, furnishing a press release titled 'Clearmind Advances Dialogue with U.S. Federal Government on Psychedelic Therapies, Submitting Recommendations to FDA.' The filing is a routine disclosure of regulatory advocacy, not a special situation. The company submitted comments under FDA Docket No. FDA-2026-N-7542 regarding psychedelic drug development, highlighting clinical trials at Yale and Johns Hopkins. No financial terms, ownership changes, or transactional mechanics are stated. There is no deal or event to trade, so no risk-arb angle applies.
